'''Shirro''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the leader of the [[Blood Razors]] [[Swoop gang/Legends|Swoop gang]] on the planet [[Biivren]].

==Personality and traits==
While projecting a rough image, Shirro was caring and concerned about the well-being of the people under his protection. He ran the Blood Razors as a way to provide support to the inhabitants of the poor sections of the industrial sector.<ref name="PSG" />

==Equipment==
Shirro carried a metal pipe to use as a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] and kept it in a sheath on his [[Swoop/Legends|swoop bike]]. He also carried a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]].<ref name="PSG" />
